About this item

  • 40% Smaller, 36% Lighter: Powered by the industry’s first TinyCell high-density battery technology, this ultra-compact 10,000mAh power bank is 40% smaller and 36% lighter than conventional power banks with the same capacity — giving you the power you need without the extra bulk in your pocket or bag.
  • 45W Pro Speed. Ready in Minutes: This 45W power bank boosts an iPhone 17 Pro Max to 76%, a Galaxy S25 Ultra to 84%, or an iPad Pro to 60% in just 30 minutes (charging from 20%) — helping you spend less time charging and more time moving.
  • Thoughtfully Designed Detachable Cable: Unlike fixed built-in cables that can ruin the whole power bank when damaged, INIU's 12cm detachable braided USB-C cable can be swapped anytime for more reliable everyday use.
  • Airline-Safe 10,000mAh Power: This airline-approved 10,000mAh power bank provides nearly 2 full charges for your smartphone—the ultimate reliable backup for flights, weekend getaways, and heavy daily commutes.
  • Trusted INIU Quality with 3-Year Care: As the SAFE Fast Charge Pro trusted by over 38 million users, we ensure the safest charging with the highest-grade materials. With our industry-leading 3-year INIU care, if you have any issues in three years, a new one is on us.
  • What You Get: INIU 10000mAh power bank*1, 12cm USB-C cable (Attached on the power bank)*1, user manual*1, and Industry-Leading 3-Year INIU Care, plus Lifetime Technical Support.

Product Description

Previous page

  • Why my power bank provide fewer charges than expect?

    Usually an external battery could supply 60%-70% power to other devices. Approximately 30-40% of the battery capacity is lost in circuit heat and voltage conversions.So a fully charged INIU 10000mAh power bank can offer 6000-7000 mAh to your devices.

  • How to calculate the possible number of charges?

    Industry-standard formula: (Power bank capacity × 65%) ÷ Device battery capacity ≈ Number of Charges.

    eg. (10,000mAh Powerbank × 0.65) ÷ 3279mAh iPhone14 battery ≈ 2.0 charges

  • How long does it take to 100% recharge?

    It depends on the power of the wall charger used: 15W charger - 2.8 hrs, 27W fast charger - 2.0 hrs.

    Note: Please recharge via the USB-C port.

  • Does it support pass-through charging?

    Yes, our power bank supports pass-through charging. You can charge both the power bank and connected devices simultaneously.

  • Is it allowed on airplanes?

    Yes, our 10000mAh power bank meets the regulations of TSA(Transportation Security Administration) for carring board(≤100wh≈27,027mAh).

      ★★★★★ Genuinely fast and nicely compact
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 October 2026
      Size Name: Mini SizeColour Name: Red
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought the INIU 45W 10000mAh power bank mainly to keep my iPhone 17 Pro topped up on the go, and it's been excellent.

      Fast charging: It supports fast charging on the iPhone 17 Pro, and you can really tell. Plugging in with a USB-C cable, my phone picks up charge quickly rather than the slow trickle I've had from cheaper power banks. It's a big improvement if you're out and about and need a fast top-up between things.

      Size and build: It's noticeably smaller than most 10000mAh banks, so it slips easily into a jacket pocket or bag. It feels solid and well made, not flimsy.

      Capacity: 10000mAh is plenty for my phone. I get a couple of full charges before it needs recharging, which easily covers a long day out.

      Heat: It only gets slightly warm while fast charging, nothing concerning.

      Verdict: Compact, quick, and reliable. If you want a power bank that keeps up with a modern iPhone without being a brick in your pocket, this is a great buy. Highly recommended.

      Small enough for a handbag, powerful enough to earn its place
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 21 August 2026
      Size Name: Mini SizeColour Name: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This has been an excellent little power bank.

      My wife keeps it in her handbag and really likes it because it’s compact, not particularly heavy and doesn’t feel like she’s carrying a small car battery around with her. It has enough capacity to charge her phone several times before the power bank itself needs recharging, which is exactly what we wanted.

      The little paw-print power indicator is a nice touch too. It’s surprisingly useful being able to see roughly how much charge is left without having to guess.

      Charging has been quick and reliable, and the built-in cable makes it very convenient when you’re out and about.

      The only slight hiccup for us was that I hadn’t realised we needed a USB-C mains charger to recharge the power bank itself, and we didn’t have one with us when it arrived. That was almost certainly more a case of me not reading the description properly than any fault with the product.

      Once we had the right charger, everything worked perfectly.

      It arrived quickly, was well packaged and has been completely reliable so far.

      Five stars from us. Small, powerful and useful — which is considerably more than can be said for most things lurking at the bottom of a handbag.

      Satisfaite et suprise
      Reviewed in France on 2 October 2022
      Size Name: Classic SizeColour Name: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Je remet les 5 étoiles, suite à ma dernière modification j'ai reçu un mail d'INIU me demandant mes coordonnées et j'ai reçu 4 jours après chez moi une nouvelle batterie neuve. Et en prime j'ai gardé celle qui était défectueuse. Très agréablement surprise et ravit. Vous pouvez acheter sereinement avec un SAV au TOP. Merci INIU

      J'ai enlevé 4 étoiles parce que je n'arrive pas rentrer en contact avec le SAV.

      J'ai envoyé un mail à l'adresse indiquée sur la notice et je n'ai aucune réponse au bout d'une semaine

      Si la seule solution est de mettre un mauvais avis, bien c'est fait.

      Mais je suis déçue quand même, au vu de la facilité pour certain d'avoir un SAV au top.

      Je reverrai mon avis si j'ai des nouvelles et vous dirais ce qu'il en est ou pas.

      Pour l'instant elle est parfaite, à confirmer sur le long terme.

      J'aime beaucoup le système de la pâte qui indique la charge, le truc qui me dérange c'est lorsque l'on charge un appareil celle-ci reste allumée et la nuit ça me dérange (je la retourne).

      Elle facile à glisser dans un sac, elle est plate et se glisse facilement.

      La pochette est un peu molletonnée pour la protéger.

      La batterie est enveloppée d'une pellicule style seconde peau qui fait qu'elle ne glisse pas des mains.

      Elle se recharge rapidement et charge rapidement.

      La notice est succincte, mais en même temps s'est pas une machine à laver.

      Je suis contente de mon achat à ce jour.

      La garantie 3 ans n'est pas négligeable et est rassurant, d'autant qu'il semblerait le service client soit très réactif.
